stem: Kicking4Hunger is different from the Care Bags Foundation in that —

options.label: F
options.text: Kicking4Hunger has adopted more goals to meet, while the Care Bags Foundation has kept the same goal but helped additional children

options.label: G
options.text: volunteers are needed to operate Kicking4Hunger, while the Care Bags Foundation can operate without volunteers

options.label: H
options.text: Kicking4Hunger donates food to assist people of all ages, while Care Bags Foundation donates toys and other items to children only

options.label: J
options.text: Kicking4Hunger has assisted children in several countries, while the Care Bags Foundation has assisted children only in the United States
